name: 男士强力塑形速干定型喷雾款
description: 强力塑形持久不塌、速干定型不粘手、雾化细腻自然光泽

styleLock.backgroundSystem: clean white panels with slim warm-grey grid lines for packshot and info screens; vivid orange flowing liquid-marble texture panels for hero and closing screens
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright warm studio lighting, directional front-left key with soft fill, soft contact shadows, controlled rim highlight on the can body
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte light-grey panel #EDEDED with thin grid lines and matte warm-orange textured panels
styleLock.typography: bold modern geometric sans-serif headlines, charcoal #33383D on light panels and white #FFFFFF on orange panels
styleLock.iconSystem: bold circular badges, simple check marks and numbered step blocks in amber accent
styleLock.presentationRules: aerosol can presented upright or with a controlled dynamic tilt, stable scale and consistent can proportions across the set, every screen composed as one complete balanced layout
styleLock.lockText: consistent energetic men's hair-styling ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, vivid warm orange #E4770F, amber accent #F5A623 and charcoal text #33383D; bright warm studio lighting with directional front-left key, soft fill and soft contact shadows; bold modern geometric sans-serif headlines, charcoal on light panels and white on orange panels; consistent circular badges, simple check marks and numbered step blocks in amber accent; slim warm-grey grid-line accents on flat panels and flowing liquid-marble texture on hero panels; clean commercial product photography mixed with bold minimal infographics; stable upright aerosol can presentation with consistent scale; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规的平台主图
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, aerosol can standing upright, full product visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, front key with soft fill, soft contact shadow
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The aerosol can standing upright, straight-on eye-level view, full product visible. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a front key and soft fill, a soft contact shadow grounding the can. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The can occupies 35-40% of the frame, centered on the clean white ground with even margins all around as a finished compliant packshot composition. 8K, commercial grooming e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no gradient background, no cut-off edges.

shots.intent: 低角度气势开场，一秒传达强力塑形的核心卖点
shots.camera: low angle looking slightly upward, can with a controlled dynamic tilt in the lower half
shots.lighting: warm directional key from the upper left with a strong rim highlight along the can edge
shots.background: vivid orange flowing liquid-marble texture #E4770F with a clean light-grey grid panel #EDEDED behind the product
shots.props: slim white grid-line accents and small arrow glyphs in #F5A623
shots.textZone: top third one bold headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #FFFFFF with one short sub-line 「{callout_1}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Medium shot photographed from a very low angle looking upward, the can placed with a controlled dynamic tilt in the lower half of the frame. Vivid orange flowing liquid-marble background #E4770F with a clean light-grey grid panel #EDEDED behind the product. Warm directional key from the upper left, strong rim highlight along the can edge, soft contact shadow. The top third carries one bold headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #FFFFFF and one short sub-line 「{callout_1}」, the tilted can and marble texture filling 60-70% of the frame as one complete balanced hero composition. Negative: no dense body text, no invented efficacy claims or numbers, no watermark, no fake logo, no brand lettering, no clutter covering the product.

shots.intent: 放大定型不持久、头发塌垮扁塌的日常尴尬
shots.camera: matched split-screen framing, identical camera and crop on both panels, back-of-head view
shots.lighting: left panel flat dull light; right panel warm directional light with soft highlight
shots.background: matte light-grey grid panel #EDEDED on both panels
shots.textZone: one short label per panel 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #33383D
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point split screen, two matched panels with identical framing and lighting setup. Left panel: the back of a generic person's head with drooping, flat, collapsed hair losing its shape under flat dull light. Right panel: the same back-of-head view with hair holding a lifted, structured shape, {product} shown beside it. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Background matte light-grey grid panel #EDEDED on both panels. One short label per panel 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #33383D. The head and product fill 50-60% per panel with the grey grid panels completing the composition. Negative: no visible face, no recognizable person, no fabricated before-after claims or statistics, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 代入出门前快速打理发型的真实瞬间，强化即喷即走
shots.camera: slight 3/4 eye-level, candid handheld feel, shot from behind the person at bathroom-counter distance
shots.lighting: soft warm morning window light from the left, 5500K, gentle haze, soft contact shadow
shots.background: matte light-stone bathroom counter and mirror in soft focus, warm neutral tones
shots.props: a folded towel and a small tray on the counter, not covering the product
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene: {product} standing on a matte light-stone #DFDAD2 bathroom counter while a generic man, seen only from behind at head-and-shoulder crop, finishes styling his hair in front of a softly blurred mirror. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed at a slight 3/4 eye-level with a candid handheld feel. Soft warm morning window light from the left, 5500K, gentle haze, soft contact shadow. Props: a folded towel and a small tray on the counter, not covering the product. The counter scene with the product and the man's back fills 40-50% of the frame with the blurred mirror and morning haze completing the composition. Negative: no visible face, no hands covering the product, no recognizable brand marks, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no messy clutter.

shots.intent: 用喷雾雾化瞬间的细腻雾感证明速干不粘手
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro on the nozzle, tight zoom on the mist burst, shallow depth of field with foreground sharp
shots.lighting: warm raking backlight from behind-right catching the mist droplets, soft fill from the left
shots.background: vivid orange liquid-marble panel #E4770F in soft blur
shots.whitespace: minimal, the mist detail is the subject
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of the fine mist burst spraying from the nozzle of {product}, tight zoom on the atomized droplets frozen mid-air. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Shallow depth of field with the foreground droplets sharp. Warm raking backlight from behind-right catching the mist, soft fill from the left, no harsh speculars on the can. Vivid orange liquid-marble background #E4770F in soft blur. The mist detail fills 55-60% of the frame with only minimal margins around it, the detail is the whole point. Negative: no blurry subject, no messy overspray, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no props.

shots.intent: 用编号步骤讲清怎么用，消除上手门槛疑虑
shots.camera: infographic layout, photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle, can upright
shots.lighting: even high-key flat lighting, no dramatic shadow
shots.background: clean white panel #FFFFFF with slim warm-grey grid lines #EDEDED
shots.props: three amber numbered step blocks and one amber capacity chip
shots.textZone: numbered steps 1-2-3 each with one short instruction line 「{callout_1}」 「{callout_2}」 「{callout_3}」 and one headline 「{selling_point_2}」 in #33383D
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic layout for {product}, flat lay photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle with the can upright. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even high-key flat lighting, no dramatic shadow. Clean white panel background #FFFFFF with slim warm-grey grid lines #EDEDED. Three amber numbered step blocks 1-2-3 in #F5A623, each with one short instruction line 「{callout_1}」 「{callout_2}」 「{callout_3}」, plus one headline 「{selling_point_2}」 in #33383D and one amber capacity chip beside the can, the steps and can filling 60-70% of the frame as one complete balanced layout. Negative: no dense body text, no tiny unreadable text, no invented usage claims, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 用对勾清单降低伤发顾虑，以罐身与喷头工艺细节背书
shots.camera: clean straight-on product angle on the left, checklist column on the right
shots.lighting: even clean studio light, soft contact shadow
shots.props: one close-up nozzle and can-finish detail panel, simple check marks in #F5A623
shots.textZone: one headline 「{selling_point_2}」 and two short trust lines 「{selling_point_3}」 「{selling_point_4}」 with check marks, in #FFFFFF
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust screen for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The can shown clean at a straight-on angle on the left beside a small close-up detail panel of the nozzle and matte can finish, so the trust reads from real product craft. Right side a checklist column with simple check marks in #F5A623 and short trust lines 「{selling_point_3}」 「{selling_point_4}」 in #FFFFFF under one headline 「{selling_point_2}」. The can, detail panel and checklist fill 50-60% of the frame as one complete balanced layout. Vivid warm orange panel background #E4770F, even clean studio light, soft contact shadow. Negative: do NOT invent certifications, awards, ratings or test data, no fabricated badges or seals, no ingredient or efficacy claims, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 组合装收口促单，用行动按钮与套组权益引导下单
shots.camera: group 3/4 view, two units of {product} arranged side by side with one slightly forward, full group visible
shots.lighting: warm punchy studio light from the upper left, soft contact shadows, clean rim highlights
shots.background: vivid orange flowing liquid-marble texture #E4770F with amber swirl accents #F5A623
shots.props: one rounded CTA button and one short offer chip in amber #F5A623
shots.textZone: one short CTA line 「{callout_4}」 in #FFFFFF on the rounded button and one short offer line 「{callout_5}」 on the amber chip
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce closing CTA shot of {product}, a group 3/4 view with two units arranged side by side, one slightly forward, full group visible. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Warm punchy studio light from the upper left, soft contact shadows, clean rim highlights on the can bodies. Vivid orange flowing liquid-marble background #E4770F with amber swirl accents #F5A623. The group occupies 55-60% overall; one rounded CTA button carries the short line 「{callout_4}」 in #FFFFFF and one amber chip carries a short offer line 「{callout_5}」, the group and buttons completing the composition. Negative: no real discount numbers or invented promotions, no dense body text, no watermark, no fake logo, no invented claims.

provenance.notes: 从 8 张爆款男士定型喷雾详情长图切片提炼；已剥离源品牌字、模特身份（发型特征泛化、只保留背影/角色）、原文案、规格数字与二维码水印；产品一律以 {product} 占位，信任镜以喷头与罐身工艺实拍呈现，不生成证书徽章。
